verdict.rationale: Audit logging and SIEM export are a fair axis for an auth service, but the evidence pack never documents auth or admin audit logs, tamper evidence, log drains, or SIEM streaming or export. Postgres triggers and lifecycle hooks are developer building blocks a user could wire up themselves, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can capture tamper-evident audit logs of authentication and admin activity and stream or export them to my SIEM
